name: S2D (Static-to-Dynamic)
authors_or_creators: Yin Chen, Jia Li, Shiguang Shan, Meng Wang, Richang Hong (and collaborators incl. Zheng Lian). Hefei University of Technology / Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences. [uncertain]
architecture_family: hybrid (ViT-based static FER backbone + temporal modeling adapters)
backbone: POSTER++ / POSTER-V2 (IR-50 + ViT image-feature backbone) extended with Temporal Modeling Adapters (TMAs)
accuracy_affectnet: Inherits POSTER++ static performance (~63-67% on AffectNet-7/8) when used as the static base; not the main contribution [uncertain]
accuracy_rafdb: Inherits POSTER++ static performance (~92% on RAF-DB) when used as the static base [uncertain]
pretrained_weights_available: yes - checkpoints for DFEW / FERV39k / MAFW released on the GitHub repo
inference_fps_or_latency: not explicitly reported; lightweight temporal adapters add minimal cost over POSTER++ [uncertain]
hardware_requirements: Training feasible on a small number of high-memory GPUs (e.g., a single or a few A100/V100); inference on a single GPU [uncertain]
loss_function: Cross-entropy classification loss; some variants use temporal consistency/auxiliary losses [uncertain]
training_data_used: Training: DFEW, FERV39k, MAFW for dynamic FER. Static-base initialized from POSTER++ pretrained on AffectNet/RAF-DB.
pretraining_strategy: Adapts a strong supervised static FER model (POSTER++/POSTER-V2) to video by inserting temporal modeling adapters and fine-tuning on dynamic FER datasets; static backbone weights largely frozen or partially tuned.
pretraining_corpus: Static FER pretraining via POSTER++: AffectNet / RAF-DB (and ImageNet/MS-Celeb-1M for backbone init)
dynamic_fer_metrics: DFEW: UAR ~65.45% / WAR ~76.03%. FERV39k: UAR ~43.97% / WAR ~52.56%. MAFW: UAR ~43.40% / WAR ~57.37%. (Values reported in the IJCV 2024 paper, achieving SOTA at submission time.) [uncertain]
abaw_metrics: An S2D-based system was used in ABAW challenge submissions for expression recognition; F1 not pinned here [uncertain]
cross_dataset_generalization: Demonstrates strong transfer of static-FER knowledge to dynamic settings; cross-dataset numbers between DFEW/FERV39k/MAFW reported in paper [uncertain]
robustness: Not explicitly evaluated on Occlusion-RAF-DB / Pose-RAF-DB; inherits robustness properties of POSTER++
explainability: Attention visualizations from the underlying POSTER++ landmark-aware cross-attention can be applied
